citation.authors: Zhang J, Wong H-S, et al.
citation.title: Dose-response effects of acute nitrate-rich beetroot juice supplementation on physiological and psychological responses during high-intensity interval cycling in women
citation.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition

population.description: Thirteen healthy, recreationally active women with a regular menstrual cycle, not on oral contraceptives (Methods 2.1; mean +/- SD). Enrolment: BMI 18.5 to 24.9 kg/m2, blood pressure below 130/80 mmHg, no cardiovascular disease or diabetes; these are criteria, not observed ranges, so min and max are null. Only the placebo trial of the crossover is entered.

protocols.name: placebo_hiie_after_meal
protocols.description: Placebo (2 x 70 mL placebo beverage, about 0.0068 mmol nitrate) taken with the standard meal (scrambled egg, chicken steak, toast; 42.2 g carbohydrate, 46 g fat, 42.2 g protein, 'including the beverage', as printed in Methods) after an 8-h overnight fast; rest 2.5 h (meal at minute 0, trial begins at minute 150); 5-min warm-up at 40 W (minutes 150-154), then 8 x [1 min at 85% PPO, 1 min at 20% PPO] (minutes 155-170: work interval k is minute 155+2(k-1), recovery k the next minute; the paper samples 'recovery period 8', so eight recoveries are taken, although its HR table lists recoveries 1 to 7 only and 'interspersed' could mean seven). The arm stops at minute 170, the last sample; the 5-min cool-down at 40 W that follows is not entered. Activity from watts, level = W/186 (no VO2 printed): PPO 123 W (mean, Methods 2.1); 40 W / 186 = 0.2151; 85% x 123 W = 104.55 W / 186 = 0.5621; 20% x 123 W = 24.6 W / 186 = 0.1323. Sampling minutes derived from the sequence: last 15 s of warm-up = minute 154, first 15 s of recovery 4 = minute 162, of recovery 8 = minute 170, end of work interval k = its last minute 155+2(k-1). Start hour 8.0 assumed (a morning, no clock printed).

protocols.name: placebo_arrival_fasted
protocols.description: Resting blood pressure on arrival after an 8-h overnight fast, 15 min seated rest, before the juice and meal; short fasted arm, sample placed at minute 15 of a 31-min arm (arrival clock not printed)
